announcements.title: District 21
announcements.description:
District 21 is a first of its kind, apocalypse themed Adventure Park. This action park is located in a 52,000 sq.ft, indoor premise with a 55ft air-conditioned atrium, within IOI City Mall, Putrajaya. Comprising 8 prominent attractions and 5 function rooms, District21 also offers an ideal venue for corporate team building events, school group visitations and birthday parties. Void of ‘passive’ rides, the credo of District 21 is Fun, Passion, and its Participation requires the engagement of the entire family. Incorporating 8 adventure attractions, many of which have never been seen in Asia, District 21 offers activities for all visitors to get you climbing, jumping, riding, sliding and flying.

Book the ticket at https://d21.ioileisure.com.my/

announcements.title: Icescape Ice Rink
announcements.description:
Time to put your skates on! Icescape welcomes all skating enthusiasts!

Located on the First Floor of IOI City Mall, The Icescape ice rink is Olympic size and perfect for hosting premier ice skating performances & competitions.

Book your ticket at https://is.ioileisure.com.my/

announcements.title: The Symphony Walk
announcements.description:
Located at the ground floor of the mall, The Symphony Walk at West Wing features stunning waterfront and al-fresco unique dining concept. Overlooking the golf course and lush greenery, The Symphony Walk also features dancing musical fountains and dazzling lights. The walkway is lined with restaurants and cafes, offering a diverse range of cuisines and beverages. Visitors can leisurely stroll along the walkway, take photos and immerse themselves in the lively atmosphere.

At the East Wing of The Symphony Walk, you’ll find the Creative Park featuring vibrant and colourful displays of LED night lights, transforming the urban landscape into a stunningly modern and futuristic world of lights. Definitely an Instagrammable spot!

The Symphony Walk is a must-visit destination for those seeking entertainment, dining, and relaxation in the heart of IOI Resort City.

announcements.title: IOI Grand Exhibition and Convention Centre
announcements.description:
IOIGECC is the best choice for some of the biggest and most important events owing to its commitment to provide first-rate facilities together with a competent, efficient, and client-oriented approach that will surely leave an impression for event-goers.

We are known for bringing your grand visions to life, from yearly award ceremonies to global conferences and exhibitions, business conventions, wedding dinners, award nights and more. We will continue to bring renowned national and international events to our community as we are proud of the legacy we have established. Our team of committed and vibrant professionals supports IOIGECC and is committed to offering our clients the best solutions, support, and experience.

announcements.title: IOI City Farm
announcements.description:
Provides a welcome contrast, offering a serene retreat for nature aficionados. Amidst lush greenery and playful farm animals, guests can reconnect with the Earth, partaking in the workshops and activities that rekindle a sense of harmony with the natural world.

Book your ticket at https://cf.ioileisure.com.my/

announcements.title: IOI Sports Centre
announcements.description:
Get ready to sweat, compete, and revel in the joy of sports like never before! IOI Sports Centre is the ultimate playground for badminton and futsal players! Challenge your friend to a game of billiards or badminton or even have a sports tournament for your company! With top-notch facilities, from pristine courts to state-of-the-art equipment, it's where your sporting dreams come alive.

Book your courts at https://sc.ioileisure.com.my/
